## Video fixes

- Transparent PNG and WebP starting images use a white background. Partially transparent edges blend into it. Hidden colors no longer bleed into the generated shot.
- Video history keeps keyboard focus during automatic refreshes. If a focused action disappears, focus returns to the same clip.
- A damaged draft now shows **Start a new draft**. Recovery saves a local backup and keeps a readable pending request available to check.

The packaged Windows app generated a one-second clip from a transparent image on an RTX 3060 in 63.4 seconds. A decoded sample of its transparent background in the first frame measured RGB 255, 255, 255. Playback and verified MP4 export passed. Regression checks passed for 26 native cases, 11 media cases, seven interface cases and two image cases. Two native fixture-writing tests were skipped.

Source commit 88ff097ecfc53f74b20bc13ed4f5f1663656404c.
